scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @sonara/api && npm run build -w @sonara/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
